scope: Whisper-derived movie and episode-preview subtitles; game-cut opening and native ending lyrics, romaji and English.

spoken.en: The continent of Claudia floats upon the Cloud Sea.
Having emerged from war, that continent...
...was about to venture into the unknown Cloud Sea.
But when a dark shadow swept across the continent...
A flash of light pierces you.
It was inevitable that the understrength AEUG would seek help from the newly arrived Astante.
Yet amid it all, people meet, then face separation in battle.
You will see the tears of time.
Those trapped by the past hunt iron warriors, drenched in blood and gunsmoke.
What role will the Astante be given here, now that it has arrived on the continent of Astragius?
Astante joins the Zelerna in opposing Drake Luft's ambitions.
There, Sho Zama of Drake's army...
...meets Marvel and begins to question the fighting.
'The One Behind It.' The clouds of war call Sho.
As we fight Mardoul, an iron ship appears before us: the Astante!
Then, as if in answer, the legendary giant Galient awakens.
'Awakening of the Iron Giant.' Stay tuned!
Let me reveal the latest information to you!
From the continent of Brave, where Posaydal's forces were driven back and peace restored...
But Posaydal's forces reappear, as though they have been lying in wait.
Final Fusion authorized next time, too!
This is the key to victory!
We're fighting Posaydal, so we're thrilled to have Astante's help!
But hey, Posaydal isn't our only enemy!
...leaves Pentagona to take its companions home.
...is met by a shining blue comet: Layzner.
A flash of light pierces you.
...Kanji spots Four, who was supposed to be dead.
Kamille rushes out of the Astante to search for Four.
You will see the tears of time.
When we embrace the new, is the old nothing but useless baggage?
Under Norstan's final onslaught, the Astante sinks in Astragius.
'A New Power.' Amid a reunion, a beloved name is called: 'Fyana!'
I declare myself a prince of the Vorder royal family and finally face Mardoul!
But when we learn Mardoul's true intentions, doubt takes hold of us.
Let me reveal the latest information to you!
Mamoru returns and performs Final Fusion into GaoGaiGar, King of the Braves.
Guy is forced into a showdown.
What will you do, our King of the Braves?
Next: Showdown! King of the Braves!!
Final Fusion authorized next time, too!
This is the key to victory!
Nobody told me you were a survivor of the Yaman dynasty!
Well, we are gaining some new friends...
...so why not ride that momentum and defeat Posaydal?
Ciela, pursued across the Cloud Sea, was the queen of the Kingdom of Na.
The Astante rescues her, unaware of who she is.
With the new Aura Battler Billbine in hand...
A swift wind calls for a showdown.
I've got my friends, after all.
Claudia—the site Binzvanker chose for the final battle.
Against Binzvanker, who has gained power beyond human limits...
A flash of light pierces you.
